contexts.text: In multiplying I will multiply thy sorrow... in sorrow thou shalt bring forth sons () = combat, and anxiety from combat... and the truths which the Church would thus produce. AC 263.
Hence the pains and torments in Hell.
The ache of our hands from the ground which Jehovah hath cursed () = that they could do nothing of good... There is labour of our hands when men have to (do this) from themselves.
This is attended with a painful tearing asunder.
With the greatest pain and torment.

With those who have conscience there arises (from the infestation and combat) a mute pain; but with those who have perception, an acute pain; and the more acute in proportion as the perception is more interior.
These Spirits... induce a pain in the head, as if from the suction of an air-pump. AC 5180.
The envy was such that it caused in them... anguish and interior pain... They were led through varieties of envy even so as to ache at heart.
The grief and intercession of the Lord for those in evil, but in some good and truth. Treated of.

When this Gentile Spirit heard of the grief of Micah on account of the loss of his graven image, grief came over him also, insomuch that he scarcely knew what to think for interior grief. His grief was perceived, and the innocence in every one of his affections...
The Lord's state... was a state of grief from love. Signified.
A solitary state, such as is that of thought in grief and despair. Signified.
The state of thought was increased to the last degree of grief. Signified.
A further degree of grief. Signified, Explained.
Those who cannot be reformed do not at all know what it is to grieve on account of being deprived of truths.

It is known that all anxiety and grief arise from being deprived of the things we love. They who are affected solely with corporeal and worldly things... grieve when they are deprived of them; but they who are affected with spiritual goods and truths... grieve when they are deprived of them... (Thus) the state of grief (of those who are being desolated as to the goods and truths which they love) is more grievous, because more interior... It is their state which is here described.
Under Despair, see this reference. AC 2698.
When the Angels merely think about such freedom... they are seized with internal pain...
The Lord's state of grief on account of the night as to the truths of faith in the Church. Signified, Explained.
To mourn regards the grief on account of the night as to the goods; and to weep, as to the truths.
Elevation from grief. Signified.
That hence at first there was grief. Signified, Explained.

That there was grief at first, was because when truths are being introduced to natural good, they at first cause pain; for they aggravate the conscience, and induce anxieties... but this first grief diminishes by degrees... It is as with a sickly body, which is to be restored to health by painful things: when in this state, it at first has grief.
The men grieved, and were very wroth () = that they were in evil against the truth of the Church with the Ancients.
When they were in pain () = cupidities. (Explained.)
When man is being purified from these loves... he is in pain and anxiety; the cupidities... are what grieve and suffer.
See Anger.
When those who had lived in... adulteries approached me, they infused a pain in the loins...
Those who are in contraries to conjugial love inflict pain in the testicles. Described.
The infernal Societies, which are in contraries, act by a severe and painful influx; but their influx is not perceived except by those who have the interiors open...
When he is in any grief from misfortunes or diseases, he can see (these truths).
The appearance of mercy with the evil, is grief on account of what they themselves suffer (by seeing their friends suffer).
They sometimes appear to have a pain as of conscience; but... it is a pain from the privation of their delight...
The removal of the evils which occasioned the grief. Signified.
In like manner in temptations, which are spiritual griefs, and thence interior miseries, and despairs, evils are removed...

Pains are sometimes felt in the skull, now in one part, now in another... such things come forth from the falsities which are from cupidities... Such nuclei, which are indurations, are broken and reduced to softness... by severe influxes of Truths, which is effected with interior pain; and also by actual rendings, which is effected with exterior pain.

When the sphere of life (of this aged adulterer) was communicated to me, it inflicted some pain on the periostea and the nerves there, as on the toes of the left foot; and, when he was permitted to emerge, on the parts where he was, especially on the periostea in the loins, and on those of the breast beneath the diaphragm, and likewise on the inside of the teeth. When his sphere was operating, it induced also a great oppression in the stomach.

Spirits from many Hells have been with me, through whom was communicated the sphere of the exhalations thence, which, as it was permitted to act into the solid parts of the body, so was I seized with a heaviness, with pain... which ceased in a moment when those Spirits were expelled.

When (these hypocrites) were allowed to inflow into the parts of the body to which they corresponded from the opposite, they injected a pain into the teeth; and, at their close presence, so grievous a one, that I could not endure it; and in proportion as they were removed, in the same proportion the pain ceased.

One whom I had known (thus) inflicted pain on my teeth and gums. When he was lifted upwards to the left, the pain attacked the left jaw, and the bone of the left temple, even to the bones of the cheek.
When (such lovers of self) are applied to a man, they induce a great pain through weariness, which they insufflate, and continually increase...
Let it not be for grief to you () = anxiety of the heart or will.
All temptations appear evil, because they are interior anxieties and pains...
If they see others more blessed than themselves, they grieve...
To be in grief on account of lost good. Signified.
To be in grief on account of lost good of truth. Signified.
For evils and falsities... induce sicknesses of mind; and at last pains.

They mourned there a great and very grievous mourning = grief... The grief here signified is the grief of initiation; for before the Knowledges of good and truth... can be implanted in good... there is grief; for another state must be induced on the Natural...
The end of the grief. Signified.
The apperception of the grief by the good of the Church. Signified.
That the end of the good Spirits is not to speak or do evil... is perceived from... their grief.
Grief on account of the endeavour to subjugate the truth of the Church. Signified.
I know their griefs () = foresight as to how much they were immersed in falsities... Griefs = immersion in falsities.
The groaning of the sons of Israel = their grief from combat.
The truths and goods which are not the Lord's, are... those which the man does in a state of misfortune, sickness, grief, and fear...
Like painful ulcers...
After they have rejected the things which had been of faith, they feel pain at the least breath of good and truth.
The chastising Spirits of Jupiter... chastise with a pain in the joints of the feet or hands, or with a pain near the epigastric region.
He said that he chastises (the man) with various pains.
These cannot be called temptations, but griefs. (Explained.)
Pain has caught hold of the inhabitants of Philistia () = despair of enlarging dominion...
The reason pain here = despair, is that the highest [degree of] pain is meant, such as that of women in labour. The word in the Original Language means such pain. Illustrated.
When truths are deficient the spiritual life labours and suffers; hence are pain and anxiety. Explained.
To sit there = permanence in a state of grief.
(This chiding Spirit) induced something of pain in the region of the abdomen.
Their grief on account of no eminence above others. Signified, Explained.
See Anxiety, here. [Swedenborg footnote 1.]. What pain of conscience is. References.
In proportion as they approach, they come into anguish and pains.
When opposite acts upon opposite, such pain is produced.
The Angels grieve most deeply that the learned ascribe all things to nature...
The Angels grieve that they do not know that faith alone is not possible...
Spiritual temptations are pains (or griefs) of mind with those in goods and truths, induced by evil Spirits...
These temptations are most grievous when conjoined with pains inflicted on the body; and still more so if these pains persist and grow worse...
Grief of heart (lest) all should perish. Signified, Explained.
Grief of heart (felt by those in the Lower Earth). Signified.
That in the degree of their elation of heart... they have internal pain after death... Signified, Explained. AR 767. Signified.
Their interior and exterior pain and mourning ... that so eminent a religiosity should be destroyed... Signified.
That the Lord will take away from them all grief of the lower mind, etc. Signified, Explained.
He said, I was tortured with interior pain...
With the pain and consequent torture in head and body I prostrated myself on the ground...
In all love there are fear and grief; fear lest it perish, and grief if it perishes.
Hell, where there are eternal pains.

Evil Spirits inhere most pertinaciously in doing evil to man, (as shown by) their inflicting pain on various parts of my body; on the feet, so that I could hardly walk; on the dorsal nerves, so that I could hardly stand; in like manner on the parts of the head; with such pertinacity that the pain and the like lasted continuously for some time... The pains were appeased and aggravated, sometimes suddenly, with various changes, as I talked with them...
Thus a most frightful sense of pain would be induced by the diabolic crew, unless God Messiah saved Souls from such a Hell.

He said he is allowed to chastise them with... pains in the joints, to such a degree of pain that they can endure it no longer, as if by a contorsion of the joints of the fingers, feet, and also by certain gentle prickings in the face, according to the permission.
Such strike a pain into the left side of my head. (Continued. See Objection.)
Sins are not remitted except from the heart, with a certain internal torture and pain.
(These lascivious girls) occasion a pain in the os pubis...
(These lascivious ones) inflict a pain in bulbum penis.
(These most deceitful ones above the head) inflicted a pain on the os pubis.
(These Sirens) struck a quite sensible pain in the region of the abdomen, which was their own anguish putting forth this effect...
(Thus) if all the reasonings of Spirits were to inflow, man would... have his head affected with such a mute pain. Described.

There have been Spirits with me who infused a pain of the teeth at the right side of the jaw, and in the flesh of the teeth there, and in the bones as far as the right ear. (They were hypocrites. Described.) The influx is into the periostea of the teeth, and also into the pericranium near the right ear, in which they create a pain quite bad and severe; an indication that they are evil. Those who do not [cause] a pain are good, and are sensible of all things which are being thought...

For some days I felt a gnashing of the teeth and a grievous pain in their roots and in the periostea from (these hypocrites). When (this cause) was removed, and in proportion as it was removed, the pain ceased. It passed also into other periostea of the head according to the diversities of its state. SE 4351. SE 4361.
There are as many Hells (as there are phantasies), with living pain, torture, and perception. Described.
(This interior hypocrite) induced pains on the part of the skull above the cerebrum, and afterwards on the part above the cerebellum.
Pain seized the flesh of the gums on the left side, so that they swelled, by which I perceived that hypocrites were present...
I also perceived a pressure and pain... at the skull... above those teeth, which was from the same source; for hypocrites strike a pain into the very Bones of the skull.
That such things have their cause in the Spiritual World has been given me to know by much experience... Such Spirits have been often and long applied to me, and have induced tortures and pains...
(On the Spirits who affect the tongue with pain.)
I felt a contraction and pain in the thoracic region, because those were there who acknowledge faith as the only means of salvation...

When (these profaners) come to man, they produce pain in the head, even in the very bones; and a pain in the shoulder, or arm... Such are those who are in a life of piety, and not in a life of charity.
(These priests, on being led upwards) began to get a pain in the knees; afterwards in the region of the stomach; and at last about the breast... Towards the higher places, the pain became grievous...

From the Hell of the hypocrites there arose an exhalation which infested the teeth and gums of the left side, both upper and lower. This lasted some hours, and I complained that I was affected with that pain... (Continued. See Luther.)
[5759a.]. Those who could strike a pain into the body and lower mind. (See Last Judgment.)
From those in falsities, the pain was terminated towards the urethra; [from those] in the love of self, towards the anus.
(Those in a holy external) operated into the lower ribs of the left side, and inflicted pain.
That as hypocrites induce pains on a tooth, so other Spirits induce other pains of the body which correspond. Example(s).
Grief of heart... Signified, Explained.
Grief of their lower mind. Signified, Explained.
Their torments from the influx of Divine good and Divine truth, are signified by, pangs and pains shall take hold on them... ().
The interiors are (then) opened... whence they have pains, anguishes, and torments...
Grief on account of the non-understanding of truth... Signified.

The shedding of tears = grief of mind; and weeping = grief of heart, on account of falsities. Grief of mind is grief of the thought and understanding... and grief of heart is grief of the affection or will...
A testification of grievous grief on account of the desolation of Divine truth in the Church. Signified, Explained.
Grievous grief and lamentation over all things of the Church. Signified.
All sadness and grief of the lower mind proceeds from an assault on the love.
That it will not receive reformation, is signified by, the pains of a travailing woman shall come upon him (). AE 721:24. AE 721:25, AE 721:26, AE 721:27.
The grief of the natural man, and the derivative grief of the spiritual man. Signified.
Lamentation over the devastation of all truth in the Church, is described by, Hear all ye peoples, and see my sorrow ().
Grief of soul and of heart. Signified, Explained.
The Arians induce a pain on the right arm, near the shoulder blade; but the Socinians induce a pain on the breast-bone.
